title: ServiceAdaptability
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — IT Service Adaptability viability dimension. Degree to which an IT service can be effectively and efficiently adapted to meet evolving user needs. Sub-characteristics: Customizability, Initiative. Rootless archetype — maps to the systemics concept of adaptation (variety absorption). Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.7.

customizability.description: Degree to which the IT service can be customized to meet individual user or consumer needs. NONE = no customization. CONFIGURATION = parameter-based customization. EXTENSION = plugin/module extensibility. FULL = fully adaptable service design.

initiative.description: Degree to which the IT service provider makes proposals for service evolution and improvement. REACTIVE = responds to change requests only. SUGGESTIVE = proposes improvements when prompted. PROACTIVE = continuously proposes evolution aligned with user needs.
